sloka: पृष्ट्वा तु कुशलं रामो वीरस्त्वां रघुनन्दनः ।अब्रवीत् परमप्रीतः कृतार्थेनान्तरात्मना ।। ६.११६.९ ।।
transliteration: pṛṣṭvā tu kuśalaṁ rāmo vīrastvāṁ raghunandanaḥ ।abravīt paramaprītaḥ kṛtārthenāntarātmanā ।। 6.116.9 ।।

translations.english: "O noble lady! I am communicating delightful news to you. O Sita, a respectable lady and knowledgeable one, the victory is attained in the combat by the great soul Rama, by virtue of your strength and devotion."
